skill.name: stripe-best-practices

content.value_statement: Stripe offers several APIs, and outdated choices can create migration or payment risks. This skill recommends current integration patterns for payments, subscriptions, and platforms.
actual_capabilities: Recommends Checkout Sessions, Payment Intents, Setup Intents, Billing, or Connect based on the payment scenario.
Compares hosted Checkout, embedded Checkout, and Payment Element integration surfaces.
Identifies deprecated Charges, Sources, Tokens, Card Element, and legacy Connect terminology.
Guides dynamic payment methods, Confirmation Tokens, and payment method saving.
Explains recommended subscription and Connect charge models using official Stripe references.
limitations: Provides guidance only and does not create, run, or test a Stripe integration.
Does not provide detailed webhook handling, idempotency, secret management, or deployment instructions.
Cannot verify account settings, API versions, regional availability, or current documentation changes.
Does not replace PCI, legal, tax, fraud, or financial compliance review.

use_cases.title: Choose a Payment Architecture
use_cases.description: Select Checkout Sessions, Payment Intents, or Billing for a new product and understand the recommended frontend surface.

use_cases.title: Modernize a Legacy Integration
use_cases.description: Identify deprecated Stripe APIs and map them to supported payment, setup, or checkout alternatives.
use_cases.target_user: Engineering teams maintaining older payment systems

use_cases.title: Design Platform Fund Flows
use_cases.description: Compare direct and destination charges, liability implications, merchant-of-record settings, and current Connect account controls.

prompt_templates.title: Select a Checkout Approach
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend a Stripe integration for [product] with [one-time or recurring] payments. Compare hosted Checkout, embedded Checkout, and Payment Element.

prompt_templates.title: Review an Existing Design
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Stripe design: [design summary]. Identify outdated APIs, recommend supported replacements, and explain each change.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Subscription Billing
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Stripe Billing approach for [business model]. Cover checkout, subscription lifecycle, payment method collection, and relevant official documentation.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate a Connect Platform
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate Connect fund flows for [platform model]. Compare direct and destination charges, liability, merchant of record, controller properties, and capabilities.

output_examples.input: We need a hosted page for one-time payments and automatic payment method selection.
output: Use Stripe-hosted Checkout with Checkout Sessions.
Enable dynamic payment methods in the Dashboard.
Validate the design with Stripe's integration options and go-live checklist.

output_examples.input: Our application saves cards through Sources and creates Charges later.
output: Migrate saved payment methods to Setup Intents.
Use Payment Intents for off-session payments.
Plan migration from Charges and Sources using official Stripe guidance.

output_examples.input: A marketplace needs the platform to accept liability for connected account negative balances.
output_examples.output: Prefer destination charges, then define merchant-of-record behavior with on_behalf_of and current Connect controller properties.

best_practices: Confirm requirements before choosing among Checkout Sessions, Payment Intents, Billing, and Connect.
Use the latest compatible Stripe API and SDK versions unless an existing system requires another version.
Validate production readiness against current official Stripe documentation and the go-live checklist.
anti_patterns: Do not recommend Charges, Sources, legacy Card Element, or outdated Connect account labels for new integrations.
Do not collect or transmit raw card data without validated PCI eligibility and controls.
Do not mix Connect charge types or hardcode payment methods without a documented requirement.

faq.question: Does this skill write Stripe integration code?
faq.answer: No. It provides architecture and API selection guidance that can inform implementation.

faq.question: Which payment API does it prefer?
faq.answer: It prefers Checkout Sessions for most on-session payments and supports Payment Intents for off-session or custom state management.

faq.question: Can it help migrate from the Charges API?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends supported alternatives and links to Stripe's official migration guidance.

faq.question: Does it cover recurring revenue?
faq.answer: Yes. It directs subscription and SaaS models toward Stripe Billing, usually combined with Checkout.

faq.question: Does it provide Connect architecture guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers recommended charge types, liability, merchant-of-record controls, controller properties, and capabilities.

faq.question: Does it guarantee PCI compliance?
faq.answer: No. PCI eligibility and compliance require validation with Stripe and qualified compliance professionals.
